lines.text: But which pairs are worth cutting?
lines.phonemes: bˌʌt wˌɪtʃ pˈɛɹz ɑːɹ wˈɜːθ kˈʌɾɪŋ?

lines.text: A Mumbai start-up sold almost 3,000 products from old jeans in its first year.
lines.tts: A Mumbai start-up sold almost three thousand products from old jeans in its first year.
lines.phonemes: ɐ mʊmbˈaɪ stˈɑːɹtˌʌp sˈoʊld ˈɔːlmoʊst θɹˈiː θˈaʊzənd pɹˈɑːdʌkts fɹʌm ˈoʊld dʒˈiːnz ɪn ɪts fˈɜːst jˈɪɹ.

lines.text: Reject thin or stretchy pairs, sort by shade, then wash and cut squares.
lines.phonemes: ɹᵻdʒˈɛkt θˈɪn ɔːɹ stɹˈɛtʃi pˈɛɹz, sˈɔːɹt baɪ ʃˈeɪd, ðˈɛn wˈɑːʃ ænd kˈʌt skwˈɛɹz.

lines.text: Ten pairs, about ₹120 of denim, make three bags and thirty patches.
lines.tts: Ten pairs, about a hundred and twenty rupees of denim, make three bags and thirty patches.
lines.phonemes: tˈɛn pˈɛɹz, ɐbˌaʊt ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd ænd twˈɛnti ɹˈuːpiːz ʌv dˈɛnɪm, mˌeɪk θɹˈiː bˈæɡz ænd θˈɜːɾi pˈætʃᵻz.

lines.text: After labour and supplies, about ₹300 is left; the patches pay for the denim.
lines.tts: After labor and supplies, about three hundred rupees is left; the patches pay for the denim.
lines.phonemes: ˈæftɚ lˈeɪbɚ ænd səplˈaɪz, ɐbˌaʊt θɹˈiː hˈʌndɹɪd ɹˈuːpiːz ɪz lˈɛft; ðə pˈætʃᵻz pˈeɪ fɚðə dˈɛnɪm.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
